    A better way to ride.

    CycleRoute helps you plan a ride through the places you want to visit.

    Best has the highest mapped cycling-path share among the routes calculated. Fastest has the shortest estimated riding time among those candidates. Neither is a guaranteed global optimum.

    Coverage counts dedicated cycleways and shared paths tagged for bicycles. On-road lanes are not counted. Map data may be incomplete; check local access and conditions.

    Search text and nearby coordinates go to Photon; selected waypoints go to BRouter; map tiles come from OpenStreetMap. Sampled route coordinates go to Open-Meteo for the ride forecast. Location is used only with your permission. Internet access is required. These community services can be temporarily unavailable.

    You can add this page to your phone’s home screen from your browser menu.
